title: A plugin's manifest (plugins/<name>/plugin.json)
description: From API 1.61 (contracts/README.md, Plugins). Not a message: a plugin is a small separate HTTP service in its own folder under plugins/; studio reads every plugins/*/plugin.json on start and at Rescan (the folder is mounted read-only), keeps it in its plugins table, and never runs or calls the plugin until an admin turns it on. v1 kinds: model-provider (Add as provider makes a local server provider from `provider`) and assistant-tools (pipelines offers `tools` to the assistant, prefixed `<name>__<tool>`). A plugin never gets the database or a secret; an assistant tool is called over HTTP with its input and a short-lived pass ($defs toolCall, toolReply). `name` is the folder's name; a manifest that fails this schema, names another folder, or whose `url` breaks the host rule of a local server is skipped (logged).

name.description: the folder's name (at most 23 characters: a provider made from it is `<name>-<8 hex>`)

kind.description: from API 1.64 skill: text that teaches the Assistant a craft (contracts/README.md, Skills)

format.description: from API 1.64, a skill's: the manifest format it is written for. This helmstudio reads 1; a higher one is listed as needs_newer and never used

when.description: a skill's: when the Assistant should read it (its one line in the prompt)

recipes.description: a skill's: settings it suggests, as data; checked against this install's workflows (one it lacks is skipped with a note)

source.description: where it comes from: a repo URL or `this repo`

may_do.description: what it may do, in the admin's words (the list's May do)

personal.description: personal use only: a provider made from it is usable only by the admin who added it (Only you)

url.description: the service's address as the stack's containers reach it, without a path; a local server's host rule (loopback, private, or host.docker.internal)

health.description: a path under url answered 2xx without a key while it runs (the Status)

start.description: how to start it, shown while it is Not running (`plugins/claude-code-bridge/run.sh`)

recipe.description: from API 1.64: one suggested setting set of a skill: a workflow id and param values. Kept only when this install has the workflow, each node and each param

params.description: values by `<node>.<param>`, as a run's inputs name them

provider.description: model-provider: an OpenAI-compatible endpoint at url + path; Add as provider makes a local server provider of these models

key_hint.description: where the admin finds the key (`BRIDGE_TOKEN in ~/.helm/claude-code-bridge.env`)

memory_gb.description: the memory reserved on the host while its provider is enabled

risk.description: any true flag asks the user first (a plugin card); all false runs at once

input.description: model-facing JSON Schema of the input: an object, self-contained (no $ref)

toolCall.description: POST <url>/tools/<tool>: the body pipelines sends, with headers `Authorization: Bearer <pass>` (short-lived, scoped to the user and the call), `X-Helm-Owner` and `X-Helm-Call` (the call id). 30 s

toolReply.description: the 200 answer: `result` goes to the model as data (never orders), `line` is the chat line (else `<title> · <tool>`), `sources` a web line's sources. Any other status is a failed call; its `{"detail": string}` is the line
